ACTIVE.description: The value of the data entity that is engaging.

FEED_HOLD.description: Motion of a component has been commanded to stop at its current position.

INTERRUPTED.description: The action of a component has been suspended due to an external signal.

OPTIONAL_STOP.description: The controllers program has been intentionally stopped

READY.description: A component is ready to engage.

PROGRAM_COMPLETED.description: The execution of the controllers program has been stopped by a command           from within the program.

PROGRAM_STOPPED.description: The execution of the controller's program has been stopped by a           command from within the program.
